lots.title: Multi-disciplinary Design Team Appointment — Stockport Town Centre School
lots.description: Single commission for an architecturally-led multi-disciplinary design team to deliver a new town centre through school on a constrained brownfield site in central Stockport. Funding secured from Greater Manchester Combined Authority covers RIBA Stage 2; contract provides an option to terminate or pause at each subsequent RIBA stage. The team must comprise Architecture, M&E, Structures & Civils, and Principal Designer (Building Regulations) / Principal Designer (CDM) disciplines.
requirements: Architecturally-led multi-disciplinary team comprising Architecture, M&E, Structures & Civils, BR PD and CDM PD disciplines.
Demonstrable experience of designing and delivering through schools of a similar size on complex, constrained, town and city centre locations.
Architect with experience of delivering educational projects (per notice description).
Team structure, key roles and responsibilities must be described; CVs required for each discipline lead (single A4 per CV, up to 5 CVs).
Team to report to the SMBC / Stockport Mayoral Development Corporation client project team at frequent intervals during the commission, including progress and stage reporting meetings.
Design must contribute positively to the town centre, complementing its unique character, historic townscape and skyline.
Inclusive design providing facilities that meet the needs of all learners.
Sustainability & future-proofing including green building standards, adaptability of spaces, active travel promotion and alignment with net zero commitments.
Climate resilience, including flood risk response (climate emergency declared 2019).
Delivery of Biodiversity Net Gain target of 20% on the brownfield site.
Navigation of brownfield development complexity including high remediation costs.
Integration with ongoing Stockport town centre £1bn regeneration programme and the 'One Stockport, One Future Plan'.

Proposed approach to developing and supporting a viable funding model, including understanding of financial challenges/opportunities, methodology for evaluating funding options (public funding streams, grants, phased delivery, partnerships, value-engineering), and integration of cost planning, risk management and lifecycle considerations.

Programme: Submit PID by 17/11/2025; Finalise Brief and prepare design scope from 12/01/2026; RIBA Stage 2 design leading to Stage 2 Cost Plan by 31/08/2026 (adjacent programme indicates RIBA Stage 2 only; wider strategic programme provided with Stage 2 documents).

warnings.message: The briefing document describes a single multi-disciplinary design team commission and does not declare numbered lots. A single lot '1' has been emitted to represent the whole appointment; daemon lot reconciliation should treat this as a single-lot process rather than inferring sub-lots per discipline.

No CPV codes are cited in the briefing document itself. The Procontract notice category ('150000 - Consultancy') is a portal category, not a CPV code, and has not been imported into cpv_codes. Downstream CPV assignment should be performed by the process enrichment step, not inferred from this briefing.

This is a professional services / consultancy tender (design team appointment). There are no discrete physical product candidates to seed; product_requirements and product_requirement_seeds are intentionally empty. Downstream product-matching stages should be gated off for this process.
